_what: Q117. scripts/check-migration-provenance.mjs judges every prod migration version NEWER than cutoff: it must have a db-deploy receipt in public.migration_deploy_ledger, or be listed in acknowledged. Versions <= cutoff predate the receipt table (20260923103737 creates it) and cannot be judged; measured 2026-09-23, the Supabase GitHub integration applied every one of the 24 migrations in the preceding 24h before db-deploy could. acknowledged is EXACT: an entry that is not an unreceipted prod version newer than cutoff fails the check.

expiredRun._why: A receipt whose GitHub run now 404s is judged by the receipt itself (scripts/lib/migrationProvenance.mjs expiredRunVerdict) once it is at least minAgeDays old: its head_sha must be a commit on main that carries the version's migration file. Measured 2026-10-17: every run of every workflow created 2026-10-01 01:40Z..2026-10-03 15:54Z answers 404 (actions/runs?created=2026-10-02 total_count 0; 2026-09-30 has 1685; the 2026-09-23 receipt runs still exist), and the 14 receipts from that window turned db-deploy red on every merge (runs 39017276439 and the 05:07Z one). A run missing sooner than minAgeDays is still a forgery: in that time the receipt was judged against its live run by every db-deploy and the nightly db-drift-detect. 14 = the repo's Actions artifact-and-log retention (repos/.../actions/permissions/artifact-and-log-retention, 2026-10-17).

lostRuns._what: Exact version + run id pairs whose run we deleted ourselves. A listed pair skips ONLY expiredRun's age test (expiredRunVerdict); its head_sha must still be a commit on main carrying the migration. Any other missing run, or a listed version with another run id, is still forged. A pair that no receipt carries, or whose run is live, fails the check as stale. Pinned by src/test/migrationProvenance.test.ts. Once a receipt is minAgeDays old the age test passes by itself; the newest was recorded 2026-10-28, so all are past it by 2026-11-12.
lostRuns.reason: The lead deleted completed GitHub Actions runs created before about 2026-10-28T18:03Z to clear space (4549 runs, stopped 19:12Z, not to be repeated), so these receipts lost their runs while under 14 days old and db-deploy run 41111832091 went red.
lostRuns.evidence: Measured about 19:14Z on 2026-10-30: GET actions/runs/<id> answers 404 for all 17 run ids; for all 47 pairs compare/<sha>...main shows main not behind head_sha and contents/supabase/migrations/<file>?ref=<sha> answers 200, and git merge-base --is-ancestor and git cat-file agree. 44 pairs are the errors in run 41111832091's log (its lookups ran 19:07:36Z..19:09:48Z). The 3 on run 40564500215 are absent from that log and 404 now, so that run was deleted after its lookup. All 107 other runs of receipts from the last 15 days are live db-deploy runs on main. Added 2026-11-01 (L29, lead approve 5:55 PM): 22 more pairs from the same 10-30 deletion (runs 41111832091, 41115469385, 41139273387, 41128285951), measured 404 by the lead at 5:55 PM on 11-01; head_sha on main is checked by the check itself (db-deploy run 41362419307 listed them).
